mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trace_annotation (trace_id, score, note, operator, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{traceId}, #{score}, #{note}, #{operator}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE score = VALUES(score), note = VALUES(note), update_time = VALUES(update_time)

INSERT INTO trace_annotation (trace_id, score, note, operator, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{traceId}, #{score}, #{note}, #{operator}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}) ON CONFLICT (trace_id, operator) DO UPDATE SET score = EXCLUDED.score, note = EXCLUDED.note, update_time = EXCLUDED.update_time
mapper.sql: id, trace_id, score, note, operator, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM trace_annotation WHERE trace_id = #{traceId} AND operator = #{operator}
